config.label: Your Gambot Token (gmbt_…) from Gambot Settings → General
config.description: Your Gambot Token (gmbt_…) from Gambot Settings → General. OPTIONAL: leave it unset if you don't have an account yet — the server then starts in token-less ONBOARDING mode (self-serve account creation only). Set it to unlock the full tool set (messaging, campaigns, CRM, bots, analytics).
